# Blender authoring tool provenance

Reviewed 2026-10-03 for issue #18. The [separate authoring lock](../../authoring.lock.json) selects the official portable Windows x64 Blender 4.5.14 LTS ZIP for creating and checking the tiny original visual fixture. It is an optional offline authoring tool; it is not a flight-core dependency, an engine export template or a simulator payload component. The native bootstrap and native dependency lock are unchanged.

The official [4.5 release directory](https://download.blender.org/release/Blender4.5/) lists the Windows ZIP, and the [release checksum manifest](https://download.blender.org/release/Blender4.5/blender-4.5.14.sha256) identifies its SHA-256. Both were fetched directly from the official HTTPS origin on the review date. The cached 398,661,046-byte ZIP hashes to `b9533d2397ac1984db4466fb23a7a4649391cca93f6e84209f9bcc60d071c8b9`, matching that manifest. Its extracted 96,093,144-byte `blender.exe` hashes to `57fa1d294ea76448c3bec84ca758caf4629611330abba7dcf55bb0c56a0a15ab`. Actual `--version` output reports Blender 4.5.14 LTS, build `62c1db4208e8`, branch `blender-v4.5-release`, Windows Release, build date 2026-09-15. The lock records these concrete identities; a later Blender release requires a new pin/review.

## Reviewed software license boundary

The official [Blender license page](https://www.blender.org/about/license/) distinguishes the application's GPL software terms, third-party components, scripts using Blender APIs, and user-created artwork. The acquired package's `copyright.txt` identifies Blender's main code as GPL version 2 or later, and its `license/license.md` describes the combined binary distribution under GPL version 3 or later with separately licensed dependencies. The package's complete component/license inventory is `license/license.md`, `license/licenses.json`, and the referenced files in `license/`; these must stay with the locally extracted tool. Exact hashes and byte lengths of the reviewed copyright and two inventory files are recorded in the authoring lock. The license page was fetched directly after the web fetch service could not retrieve it; no third-party summary substitutes for these primary statements.

This project does not redistribute Blender or copy its bundled libraries, fonts, Python modules or implementation into the simulator. Bundling this authoring tool later would require its own source/notice/package rights review; the tool lock is not that permission. The original generator invokes Blender's public Python API and declares the project's permissive MIT source terms. That does not change Blender's or its components' licenses. No unrestricted clearance for all Blender exports is inferred: the [asset review](original-render-proof.md) covers only the identified original geometry, material and animation, with no acquired artwork, imported texture or third-party source asset.

## Reproduction and limits

Use the official locked ZIP and preserve its license directory; verify archive, executable, version and build hash before authoring. [Pipeline generation instructions](../../../tools/benchmark/pipeline/README.md) run the executable explicitly in background factory-startup mode and disable backup serialization only for that process; no account, installation, system PATH change or saved user preference is required. Native build checks do not download or execute this tool. The renderer owner records actual generation/import results and the final integrated GPU benchmark separately. Editable `.blend` serialization need not be byte-identical across paths or runs; the fixed source file identity and independently checked physical output have distinct roles.
